Launch an integration with Ollama

Usage:
  ollama launch [INTEGRATION] [flags] [-- EXTRA_ARGS...]

Supported integrations:
  claude      Claude Code (alias: claude-code)
  codex       Codex
  droid       Droid
  opencode    OpenCode (aliases: opencode-cli, opencode-tool)

Flags:
      --config         Configure integration without launching
  -h, --help           help for launch
      --model string   Model to use
